edges.reason: msg.sender is compared against _from to decide whether allowance must be spent in transferFrom.
delegate() requires msg.sender == owner before performing the delegatecall.
setTradeAddress() requires msg.sender == owner before writing tradeAddress.
init() requires msg.sender == owner before setting sale limits.
batchSend() requires msg.sender == owner before distributing balances.
constructor assigns owner = msg.sender and mints the whole supply to the caller.
transfer() forwards execution to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
transfer() passes msg.sender as the _from argument.
transferFrom() calls ensure() as its whitelist/condition gate.
ensure() falls back to condition() when the sender is not whitelisted.
transferFrom() reads and writes the balanceOf mapping.
transferFrom() reads and decrements the allowance mapping.
transferFrom() increments _onSaleNum[_from] on every sale.
transferFrom() performs the unchecked balance subtraction/addition without SafeMath.
batchSend() computes total = _value * _tos.length without overflow protection.
delegate() performs a.delegatecall(b) executing arbitrary code in this contract context.
Arbitrary code executed through the delegatecall can call back into transferFrom()/transfer() with manipulated state.
ensure() reads canSale[_from] to grant a whitelist bypass.
ensure() compares _from with the tradeAddress whitelist.
ensure() compares _from/_to with owner.
ensure() compares _from with the hardcoded UNI router address.
ensure() calls pairFor() to derive the expected Uniswap pair.
ensure() stores the derived pair into the _UNI local variable.
condition() reads _onSaleNum[_from] to enforce the per-address sale count.
condition() reads _minSale to enforce the minimum transfer amount.
condition() reads _maxSale to enforce the maximum transfer amount.
condition() reads _saleNum to compare against _onSaleNum.
init() writes _minSale from the token parameter.
init() writes _maxSale from the maxToken parameter.
init() writes _saleNum from the saleNum parameter.
init() scales sale limits with decimals.
setTradeAddress() writes the addr parameter into tradeAddress.
approve() writes the allowance mapping for msg.sender/_spender.
approve() uses msg.sender as the allowance owner.
constructor sets owner.
constructor sets totalSupply from _supply.
constructor mints the supply into balanceOf[msg.sender].
constructor sets the name state variable.
constructor sets the symbol state variable.
batchSend() debits msg.sender balance and credits every recipient in balanceOf.
batchSend() uses msg.sender as the source of funds.
batchSend() computes the total local from _value and _tos.length.
batchSend() initializes and increments the loop index i.
batchSend() assigns _tos[i] into the _to loop local.

Caller supplied _from selects the account debited and the allowance spent.
_value is multiplied by the array length in the unchecked total computation.
_tos.length is used as a multiplier in the unchecked total computation.

Calldata b is supplied directly to the delegatecall.
addr is written into the tradeAddress whitelist state variable.
pairFor() result flows into the _UNI local inside ensure().

pairFor() assigns the sorted higher token address to token1.

_from parameter is used in the owner/UNI/tradeAddress whitelist comparisons inside ensure().

_value parameter is compared against _minSale and _maxSale inside condition().
saleNum parameter is stored into _saleNum by init().

_spender parameter is used as the allowance key by approve().
